name: shine-text
title: Shine Text
description: A line of text with a band of light sweeping across the glyphs.

perf.budget: Native: one text draw with a moving gradient per frame while sweeping; idle between sweeps. Web: a CSS animation.

measurements.notes: Sweeps by design while active; pass active={false} to stop.

a11y.reducedMotion: Plain text in the base colour, no sheen.
a11y.screenReader: Exposed as a single text element with the full string.
